name: spryker-community/search-feedback
description: SRP feedback ticketing: lets an authorized storefront admin file a free-text ticket about a set of search results (query, filters, page, SKUs shown), and lets Zed admins hold a conversation about it back-office. A voice-of-customer capture tool, not a ranking-signal one.

suggest.spryker-community/search-ranking: Lets a ticket's frozen SRP snapshot also carry the specificity-weighting result that scored it (TermVectorSnapshotProviderPluginInterface, implemented by search-ranking's SearchFeedbackTermVectorSnapshotProviderPlugin).
suggest.spryker-community/search-debug: The ticket 'View SRP' replay reuses the real search route (DetailController::buildSearchResultsPageUrl() -> Config::getSearchPath()), which is exactly where search-debug's overlay activates -- no integration code needed, but without it a replay only shows WHAT the customer saw, not WHY (matched tokens, business-signal contribution, BM25 explanation).

scripts-descriptions.check-floors: Verifies the declared dependency floors are real: resolves every constraint to its oldest allowed version (production deps only) and asserts each vendor symbol used in src/ actually exists there.
scripts-descriptions.rector: Applies Rector's configured rule sets (PHP floor upgrades + level-0 dead-code/code-quality) to src/ and tests/.
scripts-descriptions.rector-dry-run: Shows what Rector would change without writing anything.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan: Static analysis at level 8. Must be run from a host shop — needs the shop's generated Generated\Shared\Transfer\* classes and a freshly regenerated Ide/AutoCompletion stub.
scripts-descriptions.phpstan-ci: Standalone CI variant of the phpstan check: generates just the Transfer classes this package needs (same generator the Portable test suite uses) and ignores the two categories of class that only exist inside a real host shop (Propel Orm\Zed\* models, the aggregated Ide\AutoCompletion stub) — see phpstan.ci.neon for exactly what's excluded and why.

dependency-pins.symfony/security-guard: Resolution pin only — no src/ usage, do NOT drop in a phantom-dependency audit. Holds symfony/security-core on a PHP-8.3-compatible line; without it composer walks the spryker/api-platform -> api-platform/symfony -> symfony/security-core ^6.4||^7.0||^8.0 branch whose only self-consistent set needs security-core 8.x (php >= 8.4) and CI runs php 8.3, so 'composer install' fails outright.
